description:
# Subway Builder Japanese Trains

Subway Builder Japanese Trains is a mod for Subway Builder that adds trains from cities around Japan.

## Track Types

This mod uses a proprietary track and train separation system that allows every compatible train to run on every compatible track, allowing for easy through running and track type management when building recreations of existing systems. Each line has its own track type, named `{gauge}{line code}-{speed}`.
Initial builds should be done with a track option where applicable. Compatible tracks are listed at the end of the train name, e.g. both JP N700A Shinkansen 1435JP and JP E5 Shinkansen 1435JP are compatible with 1435JP-60, 1435JP-100, 1435JP-130, 1435JP-285, and 1435JP-320 tracks. Specific trains can be chosen afterwards in the route menu.

For further details on specific train stats please refer to the [Readme on the github](https://github.com/kaicardenas0618/japanese-trains)
